# tiny-masonry

> Zero-dependency, fast masonry layout engine for JavaScript. Under 5KB gzipped with Pinterest-style waterfall layout, responsive columns, and virtual scrolling without jQuery.

## Links
- Homepage: https://masonry.devchauhan.in
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tiny-masonry
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/dqev/tiny-masonry
- CDN bundle: https://unpkg.com/tiny-masonry/masonry.min.js
- Full API Reference: https://unpkg.com/tiny-masonry/masonry.md

## Installation
```bash
npm install tiny-masonry
```

Direct script tag:
```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/tiny-masonry/masonry.min.js"></script>
```

## Quick Start (HTML Auto-Init)
```html
<div data-masonry data-masonry-gap="12" data-masonry-columns="3">
  <div>Item 1</div>
  <div>Item 2</div>
  <div>Item 3</div>
</div>
```

## Quick Start (JavaScript API)
```javascript
import Masonry from 'tiny-masonry';

const grid = Masonry.create('#grid', {
  gap: 12,
  columnsCountBreakPoints: { 0: 1, 600: 2, 900: 3, 1200: 4 },
  virtualRender: true,
  transitionDuration: '0.2s'
});
```

## Key API Methods
- `grid.addItems(arrayOfElements)`: Append new elements to grid
- `grid.prepend(arrayOfElements)`: Prepend elements to beginning
- `grid.removeItem(element)`: Remove card from layout
- `grid.filter(selectorOrFn)`: Filter visible items
- `grid.sort(attrOrComparator)`: Sort items
- `grid.refresh()`: Recalculate layout
- `grid.destroy()`: Tear down instance and observers
